en: 1 John 3

p.src: 1  See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

en: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
u.src: 1  See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

p.src: 2  Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

en: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
u.src: 2  Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

p.src: 3  Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

en: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
u.src: 3  Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

p.src: 4  Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

en: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
u.src: 4  Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

p.src: 5  You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

en: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
u.src: 5  You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

p.src: 6  Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

en: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
u.src: 6  Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

p.src: 7  Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

en: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
u.src: 7  Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

p.src: 8  He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

en: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
u.src: 8  He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

p.src: 9  Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

en: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
u.src: 9  Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

p.src: 10  In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

en: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
u.src: 10  In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

p.src: 11  For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

en: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
u.src: 11  For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

p.src: 12  unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

en: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
u.src: 12  unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

p.src: 13  Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

en: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
u.src: 13  Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

p.src: 14  We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

en: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
u.src: 14  We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

p.src: 15  Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

en: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
u.src: 15  Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

p.src: 16  By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

en: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
u.src: 16  By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

p.src: 17  But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

en: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
u.src: 17  But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

p.src: 18  My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

en: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
u.src: 18  My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

p.src: 19  And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

en: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,
u.src: 19  And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

p.src: 20  because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

en: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
u.src: 20  because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

p.src: 21  Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

en: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
u.src: 21  Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

p.src: 22  so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

en: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
u.src: 22  so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

p.src: 23  This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

en: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
u.src: 23  This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

p.src: 24  He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

en: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
u.src: 24  He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
